title: Section 104 — poll demanded on election of chairman

content.body: Educational hypothetical, not an official statutory illustration: Members elect a chair by show of hands, but a poll is then demanded on that election. Under s. 104(2), the poll is taken forthwith under the Act; the show-of-hands chair continues until the poll elects another chair, who chairs the remainder of the meeting. Apply any different provision in the articles before using the statutory default.
